property_summary: For any caller and any payable amount, the total sum of all userBalance entries across all addresses never decreases after addToBalance() (the reference preserves total stored balances; the mutant that subtracts msg.value can reduce the total stored balance), so assert that address(c).balance equals the sum of all balances and that this sum never decreases after the call.
change_summary: Replace the addition with subtraction, decreasing the stored balance by msg.value (underflow/require may revert in 0.8, but behavior differs), changing observed balances after the call.
